// Classifier fixture, vitest: containers, describe paths, kinds, modifiers and a callback passed by
// name. Read as text by the classifier suites under tests/.
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, test } from "vitest";

describe("outer", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    reset();
  });

  describe("inner", () => {
    it.each([1, 2])("doubles %i", (n) => {
      expect(double(n)).toBe(n * 2);
    });

    it.concurrent("runs concurrently", async () => {
      expect(await one()).toBe(1);
    });
  });

  test("sits at the outer level", () => {
    // a comment the body hash ignores
    expect(one()).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe("shared", sharedSuite);
